items.t: Rear brakes grinding from stuck outer pads
items.job: Replace rear pads and rotors and service caliper slides
items.note: A seized caliper adds cost. Price is for both rear wheels.

items.t: Driver mirror glass shakes at highway speed
items.job: Replace driver mirror glass or mirror assembly

items.t: Windshield cracking without impact
items.job: Replace windshield
items.note: Check your insurance glass coverage. Camera recalibration adds cost on equipped models.

items.t: Rust and paint blisters on the liftgate
items.job: Treat rust and repaint lower liftgate
items.note: Body shop rates vary. Ask a Mazda dealer whether the corrosion warranty helps.

items.t: Liftgate may fall closed (recall)
items.job: Replace liftgate support struts
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Overheating or no heat with code P011A
items.job: Replace thermostat and refill coolant
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated badly.

items.t: Front strut bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Retighten or replace front strut mounting bolts
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Fuel filler pipe can rupture in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace or add protector to fuel filler pipe
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: LED daytime running lights failing (recall)
items.job: Replace headlamp assembly with LED running light
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer. Price is per side.

items.t: Mazda Connect screen ghost touches, freezing and reboots
items.job: Replace Mazda Connect touchscreen display
items.note: Mazda extended screen coverage and settled a class action. Check your VIN with a dealer first.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not deploy properly (recall)
items.job: Replace side curtain airbag module
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer. Price is per side.

items.t: Misfire or stalling from cylinder deactivation fault (recall)
items.job: Update engine software and inspect valve train
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN. If valve train parts are damaged, the repair costs more.

items.t: Fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Cylinder head can crack and leak coolant on the turbo engine
items.job: Replace cylinder head assembly
items.note: Mazda bulletin work; some cars were repaired under warranty.

items.t: Cylinder head can crack on the 2.5L engine
items.job: Replace cylinder head assembly

items.t: Check engine light with the thermostat stuck open
items.job: Replace engine thermostat and coolant

items.t: Creak or clunk from the steering column
items.job: Repair or replace steering column assembly

items.t: Click from the front brakes at low speed
items.job: Service front brake pads and hardware

items.t: Power liftgate can open on its own
items.job: Diagnose and replace power liftgate control unit

items.t: Chirp from the transmission on the third to fourth shift
items.job: Diagnose shift noise and service transmission fluid

items.t: Tapping or rattle from the valve train
items.job: Diagnose valve train noise

items.t: Damp seepage at the water pump bleed hole
items.job: Inspect water pump and pressure test cooling system
items.note: Replacement is often unnecessary when the level is steady.

items.t: Oil seepage on the engine front cover
items.job: Reseal engine front cover

items.t: Rear differential case can crack on all-wheel drive cars
items.job: Replace rear differential assembly

items.t: Infotainment screen blank or slow to start up
items.job: Update infotainment software

items.t: Mist inside the headlight lens
items.job: Inspect headlight housing and seals

items.t: Musty smell or water from the cabin air filter
items.job: Replace cabin air filter and clear housing drain

items.t: Trailer wiring can melt against the muffler (recall)
items.job: Reroute or replace trailer hitch wiring harness
items.note: Free under recall 17V-744 on affected vehicles. Check the VIN first.
